mapper.select: SELECT user_id, tenant_id, username, password_hash, display_name, role, status, vip_plan_code, vip_expire_time, last_login_time, fail_count, lock_until, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND username = #{username} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT user_id, tenant_id, username, display_name, role, status, vip_plan_code, vip_expire_time, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM sys_user WHERE deleted = 0 AND vip_plan_code IS NOT NULL AND vip_expire_time IS NOT NULL AND vip_expire_time < #{now} ORDER BY vip_expire_time LIMIT #{limit}
